idea: A small CLI that checks a project's .env file against .env.example and flags missing, empty or unused variables before deploy
target_market: Backend developers and small DevOps teams deploying twelve-factor apps
values: Open source first, no dark patterns, privacy by default

known_alternatives.name: dotenv-linter
known_alternatives.note: Open-source linter for .env files; checks syntax, not drift against .env.example

known_alternatives.name: The Twelve-Factor App: III. Config
known_alternatives.note: Recommends storing deploy config in environment variables, the practice this tool supports
